## Cross-platform feature check

- [ ] This change is a platform-only fix/refactor with no user-facing parity impact.
- [ ] Or: the matching iOS change is linked here: <!-- URL or commit -->
- [ ] Shared behavior, persistence, safety, error states, privacy impact, and tests were reviewed.
- [ ] Android verification is green.
- [ ] iOS verification is green, or an explicit approved exception is documented.

See [`FEATURE_PARITY.md`](../FEATURE_PARITY.md). A user-facing feature is not complete when only one
client implements it.
